rejected_implementations.reason: Controller-inline and worker persistence used separate local admission checks, permitting a global persistence high-water of two under a configured capacity of one.

rejected_implementations.reason: Retry count was bounded but exponential delay had no independent maximum.
rejected_implementations.correction: Retry delay now has an explicit configurable maximum and bounded exponent.

remaining_blockers: Persistence completion concurrent with global-loss detection and pruning needs one deterministic runtime schedule.
SharedFS read and write admission need separate or experimentally justified shared limits at scale.
Large-scale queue and fairness bounds remain unmeasured.
Real external filesystem outage semantics beyond deterministic partial-write injection remain unproved.
